chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from 'Amr ibn 'Uthman, from Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Zayd al-Shahham, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), by what he was enshrouded? He said: 'In three garments, two Suhari cloths and one Burd Hibernah garment.'

key_terms.بُرْدٍ حِبَرَةٍ: A Burd Hibernah garment (a specific type of woolen garment)
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ: Three garments / three pieces of clothing
key_terms.صُحَارِيَّيْنِ: Two Suhari cloths (a type of fine fabric from Suhar)

ai.seo_question: What specific garments were used to shroud the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi details the specific garments used to shroud the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), citing two Suhari cloths and one Burd Hibernah. In Shia jurisprudence, this narration serves as a primary textual basis for the recommended practice of using simple, white cotton garments for the deceased, emphasizing humility and adherence to the Sunnah. The mention of specific fabric types highlights the importance of material purity and the prophetic model in funeral rites.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Amro Bin Usman, from Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Zayd Al Shahham who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was asked about Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, by what he<sup>saww</sup> was enshrouded. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘In three clothes, two ‘Suhary’ fabrics and one garment wrapping’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman from Mufaddaf ibn Salih from Zayd af-Shahham who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked about the shroud of the Messenger of Allah. He (the Imam) said, ‘There were three pieces of fabric to shroud him. They were two pieces of Suhariyayn fabric and one piece of large sheet made in Hibarah.’”
